A guide snippet for Chennai says at The Life of Dance Academy fees range from Rs.3,000 to Rs.5,000 per month depending on batch level, with flexible weekday and weekend batches.
A Justdial snippet for Chennai dance classes says fees depend on class duration, trainer experience, batch size, studio facilities and course level, rather than listing a single citywide price.

strategy.market_gap: The clearest gap is a truly convenient, adult-only evening/weekend dance option for working professionals that is openly priced and easy to try without awkwardness. Competitors either publish mixed-age programs, hide pricing, or have review issues around rude staff and poor handling of customers, so none clearly owns a polished, professional experience for 22 to 40-year-old adults after work.
strategy.positioning: After-work Bollywood, hip-hop & dance fitness for working professionals — ₹999/month
strategy.price_reason: ₹999/month sits below Life Of Dance’s ₹3000 to ₹5000 per month guide range and matches Raack Academy of Dance’s published ₹999 per month offer for dance fitness/all courses. It is also far easier to compare than competitors with on-enquiry pricing like Zero 6 Dance and Fitness Company and The Workshop Dance Company.

plan.summary: The best opening is a friendly, adult-only dance class for working professionals in the evenings and on weekends, with Bollywood, hip-hop, and dance fitness in one simple offer. Competitors are weaker on convenience, clear pricing, and a welcoming first experience, so your edge is to keep the schedule easy, the message clear, and the trial low-pressure.

weeks.focus: Set up one clear offer and test interest
actions: Choose one offer for adults only: evening and weekend dance classes for working professionals.
Create a simple flyer and WhatsApp message with the class timings, dance styles, and a trial class invite.
Make a list of 30 nearby offices, coworking spaces, apartments, and resident groups to approach.

weeks.focus: Promote the trial class to nearby groups
actions: Visit 10 office parks or coworking spaces and leave flyers at reception.
Share the offer in 10 local WhatsApp groups for residents and working professionals.
Contact 10 HR, admin, or community managers and ask them to share the class with employees or residents.

weeks.focus: Run trial classes and collect feedback
actions: Run 2 trial classes, one on a weekday evening and one on a weekend.
Ask every attendee to fill a short feedback form on timing, comfort, dance style, and price.
Collect at least 10 short comments or testimonials from people who attend or show interest.
Follow up with every trial attendee on WhatsApp and invite them to join the monthly plan.
Keep the offer simple: one clear monthly fee, one clear schedule, and one easy first step to join.
Review attendance and feedback, then keep the best time slot and the most popular dance mix for the next month.
